region.name: the Honeyvale
region.blurb: Wheat fields and windmills in the west, dark pine forest and golden fields in the middle, and in the east the sickly bogs of Frogwater.

towns.name: Kingshaven
towns.blurb: The royal city of the Honeyvale: white walls, red roofs, and a castle flying the Queen's banners.

mayor.name: Countess Maud
mayor.title: Countess
mayor.avatar: plump, cheerful countess with a long golden plait, a plum-coloured cloak, and a gold chain of office
greeting: A hero, in Kingshaven! Come in, come in, mind the step.
Anything you need, ask. The Queen's champion is welcome everywhere in Kingshaven.

quest.title: The Boar King
offer: The Boar King has been prowling the road to Cloverfield, frightening every traveller. Nobody dares to use that road any more.
Beat the Boar King, and I'll make it worth your while.
quest.reminder: The Boar King is still out on the road to Cloverfield.
done: The Boar King beaten? Then Kingshaven owes you a great deal.
Here is your reward, and well earned.

shop.name: Tamsin's General Store

keeper.name: Tamsin
keeper.avatar: stubborn young shopkeeper with a smudged face and a lantern

lines: Best prices in Kingshaven! Well, the only prices in Kingshaven.

workshop.name: The Busy Anvil

keeper.name: Yvaine
keeper.avatar: strong-armed smith in a leather apron, with soot on her nose and a hammer on her belt

lines: Anvil, cauldron, grindstone: use what you like. Pedal hard and it all goes faster!

npcs.name: Rue
npcs.avatar: small child with scabby knees and a pet frog in one pocket
lines: When I grow up, I'm going to be a hero too!
The Lost Lute from Mistmarsh is hidden in the Bell Tower in Ravenpeak.

gives.line: Are you a real hero? Mum says heroes always carry healing draughts. Here, take one of mine!

npcs.name: Smith Hale
npcs.avatar: muscular smith with soot-streaked arms and a leather apron
lines: Hammer and anvil, all day long. Look at these arms!
I can build up yours too, for a fee.

spots.name: the Duck Pond
spots.text: Something glints in the mud of the duck pond. You fish out a Greater Healing Draught, and the ducks complain loudly.

towns.name: Frogwater
towns.blurb: A village on stilts over a sickly green bog. The frogs have stopped singing.

mayor.name: Margrave Ivor
mayor.title: Margrave
mayor.avatar: stout margrave with a magnificent moustache, a patched but proud coat, and a gold chain of office
greeting: *cough* Welcome, Hero. Forgive me, *cough*, the whole town has it.
Mother Blight brews the plague in a hollow past the bog. Please hurry.

shop.name: The Brave Kettle

keeper.name: Morwenna
keeper.avatar: broad-shouldered shopkeeper with rolled sleeves and a flour-dusted apron

lines: Everyone else has gone, but somebody has to sell the potions.

workshop.name: The Last Forge

keeper.name: Toby
keeper.avatar: broad smith in a scorched leather apron, with forearms like hams

lines: Fire's the one thing we have plenty of. Use the forge, and hurry.

npcs.name: Old Violet
npcs.avatar: stooped grandmother in a knitted shawl, with a basket of eggs
lines: Mother Blight? Terrible business. I've seen worse. Not much worse, mind.
Hearthblade, the Physician's Mantle and the Heartroot. The old songs say you need all three.

npcs.name: Watchman Crispin
npcs.avatar: exhausted young watchman in a battered helmet, holding a bucket
lines: Don't drink the water. Don't even look at the water.
I'd do anything for a glass of clean water.

spots.name: the Ruined Hall
spots.text: In the rubble of the old hall you find a Greater Healing Draught, somehow unbroken.

towns.name: Oakgrove
towns.blurb: Cottages with mossy roofs hide among the trees. Fireflies light the lanes at night.

mayor.name: Countess Fenella
mayor.title: Countess
mayor.avatar: elegant countess with a long golden plait, a sea-green robe, and a wheat-sheaf brooch
greeting: Ah, the Queen's champion! Welcome to Oakgrove.
The trees here are older than the kingdom. Be kind to them.

quest.title: The Great Grey Wolf
offer: The Great Grey Wolf has been prowling the road to Ravenpeak, frightening every traveller. The traders have stopped coming, and the market is empty.
Beat the Great Grey Wolf, and you'll have my thanks, and a reward besides.
quest.reminder: The Great Grey Wolf is still out on the road to Ravenpeak.
done: The Great Grey Wolf beaten? Then Oakgrove owes you a great deal.

shop.name: Morgan's Outfitters

keeper.name: Morgan
keeper.avatar: cheerful cook-turned-shopkeeper in a flour-dusted apron

lines: Bows, cloaks, and forest remedies. All handmade.

workshop.name: Kara's Woodshop

keeper.name: Kara
keeper.avatar: red-haired carpenter with a pencil behind her ear and sawdust in her hair

lines: Bark, sap and elbow grease. Help yourself to the bench.

npcs.name: Hunter Lark
npcs.avatar: weathered hunter in green leather, with a hawk on one wrist
lines: Out here, the tough get through and the rest go home.
A few coins, and I'll make you as tough as old roots.
The quickest road to Frogwater is the one from Hollywood.

npcs.name: Edmund
npcs.avatar: beekeeper in a white veiled hat, bees drifting lazily around
lines: Bees know when trouble is coming. Lately they won't leave the hive.
Never swat a bee. It only makes the others cross.

spots.name: the Old Chapel
spots.text: Behind the altar, in a dusty niche: a Rusty Key.

towns.name: Mistmarsh
towns.blurb: A village of reed huts and boardwalks over the marsh. Everyone owns a punt.

mayor.name: Countess Posy
mayor.title: Countess
mayor.avatar: broad countess with dark curls, a plum-coloured cloak, and a lapdog under one arm
greeting: Mistmarsh welcomes you, Hero. We have heard all about you.
Forgive the smell; it is the bog.

quest.title: The Lost Lute
offer: Our minstrel lost her lute, and now she just sighs all day.
She last played it in Ravenpeak, at a very long party. Bring it back and I'll make it worth your while.
quest.reminder: Any sign of the Lost Lute? She last played it in Ravenpeak, at a very long party.
done: The lute! Listen, she's playing already.
Here is your reward, and well earned.

shop.name: Ida's Curios

keeper.name: Ida
keeper.avatar: freckled shopkeeper in a patchwork apron, with a cat asleep on the counter

lines: Mind the jars. Some of them bite.

workshop.name: The Bubbling Cauldron

keeper.name: Olwen
keeper.avatar: glassblower with goggles pushed up into her curls

lines: Stir clockwise. Always clockwise. Trust me.

npcs.name: Coralie
npcs.avatar: freckled child with a wooden sword and a helmet three sizes too big
lines: When I grow up, I'm going to be a hero too!
The Silver Bell from Ravenpeak is hidden in the Old Chapel in Mistmarsh.

npcs.name: Bertram
npcs.avatar: barefoot child with a net, muddy to the knees and grinning
lines: I caught forty frogs today. I let them all go again.
The Lost Lute from Mistmarsh is hidden in the Bell Tower in Ravenpeak.

spots.name: the Reed Maze
spots.text: At the heart of the reeds, on a muddy tussock: an ember crystal.

spots.name: the Old Chapel
spots.text: Behind the altar, in a dusty niche: the Silver Bell.

towns.name: Larkstead
towns.blurb: Two banks joined by an old stone bridge, with a mill on each side and ducks everywhere.

mayor.name: Baroness Bryony
mayor.title: Baroness
mayor.avatar: elegant baroness with silver hair in a bun, a sea-green robe, and a walking stick topped with a silver fox
greeting: Larkstead welcomes you, Hero. We have heard all about you.
We are simple farmers, but we will help however we can.

quest.title: One-Eyed Jack
offer: One-Eyed Jack has been prowling the road to Hollywood, frightening every traveller. The traders have stopped coming, and the market is empty.
Beat One-Eyed Jack, and I'll make it worth your while.
quest.reminder: One-Eyed Jack is still out on the road to Hollywood.
done: One-Eyed Jack beaten? Then Larkstead owes you a great deal.

shop.name: The Busy Bee

keeper.name: Agatha
keeper.avatar: wood-elf shopkeeper with leaf-green braids and a quiver on her back

lines: Fresh bread, fresh draughts, fresh advice. What'll it be?

workshop.name: The Busy Anvil

keeper.name: Dunstan
keeper.avatar: wiry tinker with goggles, a tool belt and a grin

lines: Mind the sparks, and put the tools back where you found them.

npcs.name: Oswin the Slightly Singed
npcs.avatar: small, round wizard in a patchwork robe covered in singe marks, with spectacles on a chain
lines: Ooh, I could do wonders with you. New hair? New cloak?
Magic is cheap. Well, sixty gold. That is cheap, for magic.
There is an ember crystal hidden in the Reed Maze in Mistmarsh.

npcs.name: Miller Clover
npcs.avatar: dusty old miller with flour in the eyebrows
lines: Hear that creak? That's the wheel. It's been creaking for forty years.
Teagan's Outfitters in Hollywood sells a Physician's Mantle. It costs a fortune: 240 gold.

npcs.name: Hester
npcs.avatar: shepherd in a thick wool cloak, with a crook and a sheepdog at heel
lines: Four hundred sheep, and I know every one by name.
The Town Charter from Hollywood is hidden in the Bell Tower in Larkstead.

npcs.name: Peddler Jory
npcs.avatar: round peddler under a huge pack hung with pots and trinkets
lines: Word on the road is that Frogwater is in a bad way.
Witchery can't stand the warmth of a good fire.

spots.name: the Bell Tower
spots.text: Up among the bells, in a pigeon's nest: the Town Charter!

towns.name: Cloverfield
towns.blurb: Thatched cottages around a village green, with a maypole in the middle.

mayor.name: Count Merrick
mayor.title: Count
mayor.avatar: stout count with a neat white beard, a fur-trimmed mantle, and a wheat-sheaf brooch
greeting: Welcome to Cloverfield, Hero! The Queen's messenger said you would come.
We are simple farmers, but we will help however we can.

quest.title: The Mill Gear
offer: The mill has stopped. A gear is missing, and without it we can't grind a thing.
The miller's boy says a troll took it to Hollywood to wear as a hat. Bring it back and I'll make it worth your while.
quest.reminder: Any sign of the Mill Gear? The miller's boy says a troll took it to Hollywood to wear as a hat.
done: The gear! The mill will be turning again by supper.

shop.name: The Golden Sheaf

keeper.name: Roderic
keeper.avatar: cheerful bald merchant in a honey-coloured vest

lines: Fresh bread, fresh draughts, fresh advice. What'll it be?

workshop.name: Sage's Workshop

keeper.name: Sage
keeper.avatar: patient glassblower with singed sleeves and careful hands

lines: Anvil, cauldron, grindstone: use what you like. Pedal hard and it all goes faster!

npcs.name: Fisher Pip
npcs.avatar: weathered fisher in oilskins, with a net over one shoulder
lines: A quiet net and a calm sea. That's all I ask.
The Boar King prowls the road between Kingshaven and Cloverfield.

npcs.name: Mo
npcs.avatar: lean ferry-keeper in a wide hat, leaning on a long pole
lines: Across and back, across and back. Forty years of it.
The Mill Gear from Cloverfield is hidden in the Hollow Oak in Hollywood.

spots.name: the Old Well
spots.text: You haul up the old bucket. Tangled in the rope is a purse of 25 gold!

towns.name: Ravenpeak
towns.blurb: A mining town behind thick stone walls. Hammers ring from every tunnel.

mayor.name: Countess Linnea
mayor.title: Countess
mayor.avatar: small, brisk countess with braided red hair, a patched but proud coat, and a silver circlet
greeting: A hero, in Ravenpeak! Come in, come in, mind the step.
Watch your step. Our streets mostly go up.

quest.title: The Silver Bell
offer: Our Silver Bell was stolen! We ring it when the river floods.
A goblin ran off toward Mistmarsh with it. Bring it back and the Heartroot, which has been in my family for generations, is yours.
quest.reminder: Any sign of the Silver Bell? A goblin ran off toward Mistmarsh with it.
done: My bell! Now we'll hear the floods coming.
As promised: the Heartroot. May it serve you well against Mother Blight.

shop.name: The Iron Anvil

keeper.name: Hugo
keeper.avatar: red-haired ex-sailor with a tattooed forearm and a gold earring

lines: Forged in the mountain, cooled in snowmelt. Take a look.

workshop.name: The Stonecutter's Yard

keeper.name: Edith
keeper.avatar: strong-armed smith in a leather apron, with soot on her nose and a hammer on her belt

lines: The best anvil this side of the mountains. Strike while it's hot!

npcs.name: Herbalist Ottilie
npcs.avatar: herbalist in a green apron, with bundles of drying herbs hanging from the belt
lines: Every potion is a little poem, if you know how to read it.
Lessons are cheap. Not knowing is expensive.
Hearthblade can't be bought or found: it has to be made, at the workshop in any town, from an iron sword, forged again in the heat of an ember crystal. It takes a few minutes of hard pedaling.

npcs.name: Grandpa Digby
npcs.avatar: white-bearded grandfather on a bench, with a walking stick across his knees
lines: Back in my day the roads were safe. Mostly. Sometimes.
There is an ember crystal hidden in the Reed Maze in Mistmarsh.

npcs.name: Sabine
npcs.avatar: shepherd in a thick wool cloak, with a crook and a sheepdog at heel
lines: The wolves have been bold this year. Keep to the road.
The Silver Bell from Ravenpeak is hidden in the Old Chapel in Mistmarsh.

npcs.name: Zinnia
npcs.avatar: cheerful minstrel in a feathered cap, with a fiddle under one arm
lines: They sing about Mother Blight in every tavern now. Not happy songs.
The Great Grey Wolf prowls the road between Oakgrove and Ravenpeak.

spots.name: the Bell Tower
spots.text: Up among the bells, in a pigeon's nest: the Lost Lute!

towns.name: Hollywood
towns.blurb: Cottages with mossy roofs hide among the trees. Fireflies light the lanes at night.

mayor.name: Countess Wilhelmina
mayor.title: Countess
mayor.avatar: elegant countess with braided red hair, a long blue coat with silver buttons, and a walking stick topped with a silver fox
greeting: Welcome to Hollywood, Hero! The Queen's messenger said you would come.

quest.title: The Town Charter
offer: The town charter is gone! Without it, Hollywood has no rights at all.
A magpie flew off toward Larkstead with it. Magpies love parchment. Bring it back and I'll make it worth your while.
quest.reminder: Any sign of the Town Charter? A magpie flew off toward Larkstead with it. Magpies love parchment.
done: The charter! Hollywood is a proper town again.

shop.name: Teagan's Outfitters

keeper.name: Teagan
keeper.avatar: red-headed shopkeeper who hums while counting coins

lines: Bows, cloaks, and forest remedies. All handmade.

workshop.name: The Whittled Owl

keeper.name: Nessa
keeper.avatar: red-haired carpenter with a pencil behind her ear and sawdust in her hair

lines: The grindstone sings when you pedal fast. Make it sing!

npcs.name: Rook
npcs.avatar: freckled child with a wooden sword and a helmet three sizes too big
lines: When I grow up, I'm going to be a hero too!
The Golden Sheaf in Cloverfield sells iron swords.

npcs.name: Quentin
npcs.avatar: beekeeper in a white veiled hat, bees drifting lazily around
lines: My bees make the sweetest honey in the Honeyvale.
One-Eyed Jack prowls the road between Larkstead and Hollywood.

npcs.name: Granny Beatrix
npcs.avatar: tiny, kindly witch in a mossy shawl, with a toad sitting on her hat
lines: Not all witches are wicked, dearie.
The Mill Gear from Cloverfield is hidden in the Hollow Oak in Hollywood.

npcs.name: Tam
npcs.avatar: cheerful minstrel in a feathered cap, with a fiddle under one arm
lines: I'm writing a song about you! So far it's mostly about your boots.
The Town Charter from Hollywood is hidden in the Bell Tower in Larkstead.

spots.name: the Hollow Oak
spots.text: Deep inside the hollow oak, among old acorns and junk, something glints: the Mill Gear!

spots.name: the Old Chest
spots.text: The Rusty Key turns with a screech. Inside the old chest: a Tome of Might!
spots.lockedText: A heavy chest sits in the corner, locked tight. The keyhole is caked with rust.

enemies.name: Grey Wolf
enemies.taunt: A wolf slinks out of the grass, teeth bared.

enemies.name: Angry Swan
enemies.taunt: A swan spreads its wings and hisses like a kettle. It wants the whole road to itself.

enemies.name: Plague Rats
enemies.taunt: A tide of rats pours across the road, squeaking.

enemies.name: Witch's Owl
enemies.taunt: An owl with glowing green eyes swoops at you. It does not hoot. It cackles.

enemies.name: Bog Lurker
enemies.taunt: Something scaly rises from the muck.

enemies.name: Brown Bear
enemies.taunt: A bear rears up on its hind legs. It smells of honey and bad temper.

enemies.name: Wild Boar
enemies.taunt: A boar paws the ground and snorts.

enemies.name: Giant Spider
enemies.taunt: A spider as big as a pony drops from the branches on a silver thread.

enemies.name: Goblin Scout
enemies.taunt: A goblin cackles and waves a rusty knife.

enemies.name: Giant Toad
enemies.taunt: A toad the size of a barrel blinks at you, then flicks out a very long tongue.

enemies.name: Marsh Wisp
enemies.taunt: A pale light drifts closer, whispering your name.

enemies.name: the Boar King
enemies.taunt: A boar as big as an ox, with tusks like scythes, snorts in the middle of the road.
enemies.avatar: enormous black boar with a bristling mane and cracked yellow tusks

enemies.name: the Great Grey Wolf
enemies.taunt: A wolf as big as a pony blocks the road. Its eyes are yellow lamps.
enemies.avatar: enormous grey wolf with a torn ear and yellow eyes

enemies.name: One-Eyed Jack
enemies.taunt: "One-Eyed Jack, at your service. Now hand over everything shiny."
enemies.avatar: lanky bandit chief with an eyepatch, a feathered hat and far too many daggers

enemies.name: Old Mother Blight
enemies.taunt: "Everything rots in the end, dearie. I just help it along."
enemies.avatar: tall green-faced witch with a crooked nose and a cloak that drips bog water

The Golden Sheaf in Cloverfield sells iron swords.
There is an ember crystal hidden in the Reed Maze in Mistmarsh.
Teagan's Outfitters in Hollywood sells a Physician's Mantle. It costs a fortune: 240 gold.
Only a Physician's Mantle can turn Mother Blight's poison. Teagan's Outfitters in Hollywood has one.
Countess Linnea of Ravenpeak would give the Heartroot to whoever brings back the lost Silver Bell.
The Silver Bell from Ravenpeak is hidden in the Old Chapel in Mistmarsh.
The Boar King prowls the road between Kingshaven and Cloverfield.
The Great Grey Wolf prowls the road between Oakgrove and Ravenpeak.
The Lost Lute from Mistmarsh is hidden in the Bell Tower in Ravenpeak.
One-Eyed Jack prowls the road between Larkstead and Hollywood.
The Mill Gear from Cloverfield is hidden in the Hollow Oak in Hollywood.
The Town Charter from Hollywood is hidden in the Bell Tower in Larkstead.
The Old Chest in Hollywood is locked. Its key was lost in the Old Chapel in Oakgrove years ago.
To defeat Mother Blight you need Hearthblade, the Physician's Mantle and the Heartroot.
Witchery can't stand the warmth of a good fire.
The quickest road to Frogwater is the one from Hollywood.

challenge.title: The Witch of Frogwater
summons: Hero, thank you for coming so swiftly. Grave news has reached the throne.
Old Mother Blight has brewed a plague in the bogs near Frogwater. Crops are rotting, the wells are turning green, and folk are falling ill.
Our scholars say three things can bring Mother Blight down: the Hearthblade, forged in kitchen fires, a Physician's Mantle against the plague, and the Heartroot, which cures any blight.
Find all three, then face Mother Blight at the Blighted Hollow. Ask everyone you meet; the people of the Honeyvale know more than they think.
Take this purse and these draughts. My carriage will carry you to Kingshaven. Everwyn is counting on you.

lair.name: the Blighted Hollow
lair.text: A crooked cottage in a hollow of dead trees. Green smoke leaks from its chimney.

victory: You drop the Heartroot into the town well, and the green water runs clear.
Hearthblade blazes like a hearth fire. With a shriek, Mother Blight melts into a puddle of bog water.
The fever breaks all over Frogwater. By morning, the gardens are green again.
